items.description:
Stylistics Hair Studio is a hair salon at 48 Dover Road in Heathfield, Cape Town. Its team of practitioners is rated 4.9 out of 5 from more than 1,000 reviews on its Fresha booking page. The studio offers wash, blow dry and iron services, cuts and trims and consultations, with listed prices from R154 to R275.

The business is also a training centre, according to its listing, and it offers nail services alongside hair work. Laser hair removal is planned as a future addition. Clients can book online with instant confirmation, and the salon suits people in Heathfield and nearby suburbs who want hair and nail services in one place.

Sunrise Farm is a halaal livestock abattoir in Schaapkraal, in the Philippi Horticultural Area of Cape Town, and has been operating since 1987. The business provides a strict halaal slaughter of sheep, goats and cows for religious and cultural needs. Its services cover slaughtering, skinning, cleaning, cutting, packaging, refrigeration and delivery of the product.

The farm is run by its owner, and its website says the staff are ready to help with questions about the services. Customers can also place orders online. The farm suits customers who need halaal meat processed and delivered, and it is a long-standing option in the Philippi area.

The Best Laser & Skin is a beauty and skin clinic at 25 Derry Street in Vredehoek, Cape Town, with a team of more than 12 practitioners. Its menu includes laser hair removal, laser photo rejuvenation, pico laser skin rejuvenation, tattoo removal, Botox and fillers, and facials for acne, pigmentation and ageing.

Treatments also include microneedling, radiofrequency needling, HIFU, microdermabrasion and skin peels, and the clinic offers skin analysis before treatment. Clients can book online with instant confirmation, and the practice has parking and showers. With a 4.9 rating from more than 1,800 reviews on Fresha, the clinic suits people who want laser and skin treatments in Vredehoek and nearby areas.

weClean is a cleaning company serving Richwood and the wider Cape Town area. Its services cover commercial and office cleaning, carpet cleaning, upholstery cleaning, mattress cleaning and fogging disinfection, and it also sells cleaning chemicals.

The company says it has the specialised chemicals and deep-cleaning machines needed for dirty carpets, and that its methods are fast and efficient. Residents of Richwood can book carpet, upholstery or mattress cleaning, and businesses can use the office and commercial service. Quotes can be requested through the website, which also publishes a price list. It suits homeowners and offices that want deep cleaning done by a local team.

Bistro Sixteen82 is a casual bistro on Steenberg Farm, Steenberg Road in Tokai, set within a working winery. The menu runs from breakfast and lunch through to tapas-style dinners, with an all-day menu available between the main services. Its listing describes fresh seasonal dishes and views over the vineyards and mountains.

The bistro's own site lists Monday to Sunday opening, and diners can reserve a table online. The estate also runs wine tastings and a wine club, which guests can combine with a meal at the bistro. It suits visitors to the Steenberg wine estate who want breakfast, a relaxed lunch or tapas in the same visit.

Bo-Kaap Deli is a neighbourhood cafe and deli at 114 Church Street in the Bo-Kaap, Cape Town. It serves freshly prepared meals that blend Cape Malay influences with modern comfort food. The deli also makes artisanal breads, quality coffees and house-made treats, including koeksisters.

Its own page describes the deli as neighbourhood-driven and rooted in the heritage and flavours of the Bo Kaap, in a warm and welcoming space where culture and community come together. Its Facebook page calls it a local cafe and restaurant with traditional Cape Malay flair, serving locals, visitors and working professionals. It suits anyone who wants a casual meal or coffee in one of Cape Town's historic neighbourhoods.

Col'Cacchio GO is a fast, takeaway-focused outlet of the Col'Cacchio pizza brand, in the Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, Cape Town. The brand was born from one of South Africa's most loved Italian-inspired restaurant names, and this outlet brings that gourmet flavour to the heart of the market. It serves handcrafted wood-fired pizzas, pastas and salads made with premium, wholesome ingredients, with a focus on food that is fast, fresh and full of flavour.

The outlet suits shoppers and visitors to the Old Biscuit Mill who want to explore the market, meet friends or grab lunch on the go. Orders can be taken for collection or delivery, and the outlet is listed among the Old Biscuit Mill's food and drink tenants. It is a quick option for anyone already in the Woodstock market.

De Kock Estates is a real estate agency serving the False Bay area and surrounding suburbs, with an office in Fish Hoek. It handles property sales and rentals, and its site groups listings by suburb, including Fish Hoek, Pinelands, Century City and Rondebosch.

The site shows featured properties for sale and rent, along with a record of sold properties, so buyers and tenants can see recent activity. Its listings include residential properties in Century City and Milnerton as well as the False Bay area. The agency suits sellers, landlords and tenants who want an agent with a long local presence in False Bay.

Whitney's Hair & Beauty Boutique is a hair and beauty salon in Kromboom Convenience Centre in Crawford, Cape Town. Its services include balayage, highlights, hair colouring, blow dries, hair extensions and weaves, along with keratin and permanent straightening treatments, perms and women's haircuts. The salon also offers children's haircuts and hair botox, according to the business listing.

Clients can book through the salon's Fresha listing, which shows its address at Shop 6 and a call-to-book option. The range covers colour, styling and treatments, so the salon suits clients of all ages who want that work handled close to home in Crawford.
